context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Attached are 5 dense contact sheets, each 96 frames (8 columns x 12 rows, chronological) of one Tesla Sentry clip labelled as containing a door ding. For EACH, decide whether the moment of physical contact between the door/object and the car is VISIBLE in the supplied frames. Output one line per image:
<name>: EVIDENCE=direct|indirect|indeterminate; FRAME=<1-96 or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 15 words>
direct = contact visibly occurs (door meets body); indirect = aftermath/motion implies it but the touch isn't seen; indeterminate = cannot tell.
Images:
Image 1: garage-mustang-door
Image 2: rd-18onveu-littering-door-ding-combo-while-looking-into
Image 3: rd-1b9sobq-identify-car-parking-lot-ding
Image 4: rd-1baaqtc-door-ding-found-culprit-what-would-you-do-ne
Image 5: rd-1j18tgo-i-caught-the-culprit-who-scratched-my-car
response:
garage-mustang-door: EVIDENCE=indeterminate; FRAME=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Open door remains nearby; no visible meeting with the recording car’s body.
rd-18onveu-littering-door-ding-combo-while-looking-into: EVIDENCE=indeterminate; FRAME=none; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Darkness and occlusion obscure the door edge; contact with the recording car is not visible.
rd-1b9sobq-identify-car-parking-lot-ding: EVIDENCE=indeterminate; FRAME=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Door opens toward camera, but foreground people obscure any possible contact point.
rd-1baaqtc-door-ding-found-culprit-what-would-you-do-ne: EVIDENCE=indeterminate; FRAME=none; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Door swings toward frame boundary; cropping and blur prevent seeing whether it touches.
rd-1j18tgo-i-caught-the-culprit-who-scratched-my-car: EVIDENCE=indeterminate; FRAME=none; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Door approaches the left foreground, but no unambiguous door-to-body contact is resolved.
